title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
ADA: CME futures hit 6-month mark today — SEC can now fast-track Grayscale spot ADA ETF; 75-day review window points to Oct 23 decision.
CLARITY Act: cloture motion filed Aug 8 — Senate vote now set for September return, not shelved outright.
Ahead: Jackson Hole Aug 27-29 — Warsh's first keynote as Fed chair; theme is "Financial Innovation."
Prices quiet: BTC +1.2% 24h (~$64,752), below alert thresholds. Gold dedup active. No data releases.
